A WORK IN PROGRESS

An idea with people at its heart.

This is the first preview of an independent project started by a CodeYourFuture London trainee to help emerging developers connect with employers.

All names, project descriptions and experience on the example profiles are fictional. The three example portraits are AI-generated and do not depict real candidates. They demonstrate how a future participant could present their work. There are no real candidates, partner endorsements or hiring guarantees on this preview.

Forms open email drafts addressed to thejuniordeveloperacademy@gmail.com. You choose whether to send them in your email app. You can also download a text draft. This website does not publish profiles, save form details to a server, or use analytics, tracking cookies or browser storage.

Before real profiles go live, participants will approve their information. Contact the organiser at thejuniordeveloperacademy@gmail.com.
